description:
Cast Last Voyage of the _____ by paying {3}{B}.
Last Voyage of the _____'s first ability triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Last Voyage of the _____ to it.
Leonin Relic-Warder's first ability triggers, exiling Last Voyage of the _____.
Last Voyage of the _____'s last abiltiy triggers, causing you to sacrifice Leonin Relic-Warder.
Leonin Relic-Warder's last ability triggers, returning Last Voyage of the _____ from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
